# How many employees does Leena AI have?

Leena AI, Inc. has approximately389 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Leena AI’s total headcount has declined6.9% from 418 employees in 2023 to 389 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Leena AI hiring right now?

Yes, Leena AI isactively hiring. Leena AI had47 active job postings in 2026, a 64.8% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/leena-ai/employees#postings).

## About Leena AI’s Workforce

Leena AI, Inc. is an Information Technology Services company that employs **389** people worldwide as of June 2026. It is the 10th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/leena-ai/employees#similar-companies). Founded in 2015, the company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Leena AI's workforce has declined **6.9%** from 2023 to 2026, though it is up **0.1%** year over year in 2026. It fell to a low of **333** in 2025 Q3 before recovering. Its workforce is concentrated most in South Asia ( **76.6%**), followed by North America ( **20.6%**) and Northern Europe ( **1.1%**).

Leena AI's functional groups are Finance and Operations ( **40.3%**), Engineering ( **35.2%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **24.5%**), with Sales and Marketing growing fastest (up **23.0%**). The average salary is **$49,273,** ranging from a median of **$135,000** in Northern Europe to **$19,000** in South Asia, up **9.9%** year over year in 2026.

Leena AI's active job postings rose **64.8%** in 2026 to **47**, with new postings per month climbing from **33** in 2023 to **37** in 2026. Overall employee sentiment is neutral but declining.
